_comment: Plugin hook wiring. Both guards read only the staged index and fail OPEN: if a script cannot run, the commit proceeds. The .sh forms are used because bash is present wherever Claude Code's Bash tool works, including Windows via Git Bash. The .sh guards do the scan in one python3 process when python3 exists; without it they fall back to a bash loop that has stalled intermittently on Git Bash, so Windows users without python3 should wire the .ps1 forms per repo instead (docs/HOOKS.md). The build gate is not wired here because its command depends on your stack: copy hooks/build-gate.example.json into your project's .claude/settings.json and set the command.
